meta.about: The resident's page: each example as the city's status page shows it today (replica, block level, request number withheld) and with the fix (illustration on the request's own dates). Written by hand from the sources listed per example; no request, work-order or parcel numbers.
sources: research/status-page-linkage.md (page fields and labels, the CSB line on 160 of 160 pages, the Closed tooltip on 1,150 pages)
research/north-taylor-mechanism.md (lot-1: last billed cut 24 Oct 2024, none in 2025-26)
311 file of 13 Oct 2026 via build/N5/private/n5.duckdb (dates only: investigation-completed dates, the 9 Sep call, the tree address's other two requests)
